meta.title: Aardio toolchain
meta.description: Write aardio code with three bundled skills, search your own aardio documentation, examples, and library sources, and open files or projects in the aardio IDE. You choose where aardio lives: open this bundle on the Plugins page, pick the dsh-aardio row, and choose Configure to point it at the folder that contains aardio.exe; leave it empty to detect the installation automatically.
